title: QAOA-Based Pilot Assignment for Cell-Free Massive MIMO Systems
summary: Pilot contamination is a major challenge in cell-free massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) systems, where the limited number of orthogonal pilots makes pilot reuse unavoidable. Since the pilot assignment solution space grows exponentially with the number of users, finding the global optimum becomes computationally challenging on classical computers. Recent advances in quantum computing provide a promising approach for solving such large-scale combinatorial optimization problems.
